par.source: Ensembl GRCm38 pseudoautosomal region (chrX:169,969,759-171,031,299; chrY:90,745,845-91,644,698), converted from 1-based inclusive to 0-based half-open

xtr.source: The mouse genome has no X-transposed region; empty by design

chrY.label: AMPLICONIC_YQ
chrY.reason: Mouse Yq is ampliconic (Sly, Ssty1/2, Srsy multicopy families); copy number varies between strains and MAPQ>=20 depth is near zero, so it is not a single-copy dosage readout

notes: Single-copy mouse Yp (Kdm5d, Eif2s3y, Uty, Ddx3y, Usp9y, Zfy1/2, Sry) lies below 4 Mb in GRCm38; multicopy Yp clusters (e.g. Rbmy) are removed by the gates' per-interval callability rule, not by this mask.
The X compartment depends only on the PAR boundary at the distal end of chrX.
